name: Grilled pork
summary: Pork grilled on skewers or whole at the Jrai tables of Tân Sơn, eaten with sticky rice from a bamboo tube.
origin: VnExpress International’s Teng village account, in Tân Sơn commune, puts skewered or whole grilled pork next to the chicken and the bamboo rice. The tourism article on Tân Sơn names heo nướng xiên at Jrai tables there.
howToEat: Eat it with cơm lam, the sticky rice steamed in bamboo.
where: Teng village, Tân Sơn commune, Pleiku.
seoDescription: Skewered or whole grilled pork with bamboo-tube sticky rice at Teng village in Tân Sơn, near Pleiku.
